test_cases.description: Verifies that request_with_retry retries on ConnectTimeout/ConnectError/ReadTimeout but not on HTTP 4xx/5xx responses.
preconditions: asyncio.sleep is patchable to avoid real waits
test_cases.expected: After 2 transient failures, successful response returned on 3rd attempt; total attempts == 3
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
call_count = 0
async def fake_method(url, **kwargs):
    nonlocal call_count
    call_count += 1
    if call_count < 3:
        raise httpx.ConnectTimeout('timeout')
    return MockResponse(200)
with patch('asyncio.sleep'):
    result = await request_with_retry('get', 'https://example.com', timeout=httpx.Timeout(5))
assert result.status_code == 200
assert call_count == 3
# Also verify 429 is returned without retry
call_count_429 = 0
async def fake_429(url, **kwargs):
    nonlocal call_count_429
    call_count_429 += 1
    return MockResponse(429)
result_429 = await request_with_retry('get', 'https://example.com', timeout=httpx.Timeout(5))
assert result_429.status_code == 429
assert call_count_429 == 1
